findings.problem: explicit jihvāmūlīya/upadhmānīya passes through to the Kannada model text where it is out-of-vocabulary
findings.fix: fold to plain visarga before Kannada routing (Vāgdhenu does this only in the phonetic_mfa kannada_safe arm)

findings.problem: explicit jihvāmūlīya/upadhmānīya is dropped (not mapped to H/Z/V)
findings.fix: map U+1CF5→'Z', U+1CF6→'V' (Vāgdhenu tts_g2p convention) or at least to 'H'

findings.problem: explicit jihvāmūlīya/upadhmānīya passes through to the Kannada model text where it is out-of-vocabulary
findings.fix: fold to plain visarga before Kannada routing (Vāgdhenu does this only in the phonetic_mfa kannada_safe arm)

findings.problem: anusvāra before y kept as ं (tts_normalize.py turns it into candrabindu) — the two Vāgdhenu normalisers disagree
findings.fix: pick one rule for Kamadhenu and document it

findings.problem: Kannada input is not transliterated by the Devanagari path; build_search_index folds Kannada→Devanagari by code-point shift first, texts.py must do the same before Chandas
no path preserves udātta/anudātta/svarita — Vedic accent is out of scope for every existing frontend
findings.fix: separate Vedic annotation track (tts/ARCHITECTURE.md §Vedic) — Stage 6 only

findings.problem: chant echo-vowel (rāmaḥ→rāmaha) is applied to the last word — a tradition-specific pronunciation choice, must be a per-project switch
findings.fix: expose as a parameter in the Kamadhenu frontend; default follows the lead's recitation style

findings.problem: applies utva/rutva/lopa visarga sandhi at word boundaries — changes the text that will be spoken; DGE has no equivalent, and this must NOT be applied when the recording already has plain visarga
findings.fix: keep as an explicit, logged pronunciation transform; never rewrite DGE canonical text

findings.problem: DGE has no reusable Sanskrit syllabifier outside chandas.js (browser JS, Devanagari-only, ल/ग alphabet); Vāgdhenu has two (tts_syllabify.py maximize-onset, chandas_labeler.py orthographic) that count the same but split codas differently
findings.fix: Kamadhenu wraps chandas.js headlessly (done: tools/kamadhenu/chandas_runner.js); a Python port is NOT needed for the dataset stage

findings.problem: neither project has a phonemic G2P beyond SLP1 = one char per phone; Vāgdhenu deliberately feeds Kannada script to IndicF5 and lets the model learn pronunciation acoustically
findings.fix: for Kamadhenu keep SLP1 as the internal representation; script routing (Devanagari vs Kannada) is a model-side choice to re-test on the lead's voice

findings.problem: pāda boundaries come only from line breaks / daṇḍas in the source text; where a verse is stored as two hemistich lines the engine splits at the syllable midpoint, which is wrong for uneven ardhasama/viṣama metres
findings.fix: store pāda-split text in DGE for reference-bank verses (human-checked), or derive from the metre's per-pāda syllable count

findings.case: text defects surface as metre failures
findings.problem: unequal pāda counts / typos in the corpus (e.g. सिधुः for सिन्धुः in Tīrthaprabandha TP_DAK_003; 23/22-syllable halves in Sumadhva Vijaya 1.17) make the engine return अज्ञातम्
findings.fix: route these to the DGE correction workflow; they are corpus bugs, not engine bugs

checklist.Unicode normalization: DGE: NFC in clean_devanagari + subanta slp; Vāgdhenu: none explicit (sanscript tolerates NFC) — PARTIAL
checklist.Kannada: DGE search folds by code-point shift; Vāgdhenu detect_script→sanscript; chandas.js NO — PARTIAL
checklist.SLP1/internal: both use SLP1 (DGE search_toolkit; Vāgdhenu sanscript) — DONE
checklist.vowels & length: preserved in SLP1 by both; DGE phonetic_key deliberately folds length (search only, never for TTS) — DONE for TTS path
checklist.anusvāra: kept as M by both; homorganic-nasal rewrite only in Vāgdhenu — PARTIAL
checklist.visarga: kept as H; Vāgdhenu sandhi/echo transforms optional — PARTIAL
checklist.jihvāmūlīya/upadhmānīya: Vāgdhenu tts_normalize emits them; DGE drops them — NOT STARTED in DGE
checklist.geminates: preserved in SLP1; DGE phonetic_key collapses them (search only) — DONE for TTS path
checklist.conjuncts: preserved; chandas.js counts cluster weight — DONE
checklist.word boundaries: spaces preserved; hyphenated compounds in Sumadhva Vijaya source need joining — PARTIAL
checklist.daṇḍa: stripped by both (kept as pause token only in Vāgdhenu tts_g2p) — DONE
checklist.sandhi: Vāgdhenu word-boundary visarga sandhi only; no general sandhi engine anywhere — PARTIAL
checklist.pronunciation transformations: Vāgdhenu: ṝ→rū, hna metathesis, echo visarga, vocalic ḷ; DGE: none — PARTIAL
